purpose: Lower validation MAE of the selected residual CNN (residual_identity). Written before any search run.
selection_data: Validation only. Rolling folds: A = Jan-Jun 2022 (train before), B = Jan-Jun 2023, C = frozen validation Jan-Jun 2024. Train boundary purged so targets mature before first validation issue.
acceptance_rule: Lower mean pooled validation MAE than baseline AND macro provincial MAPE not higher.
final: Fit only the best accepted candidate on the frozen split with 3 seeds; evaluate test2024 and test2025 once.
caveats: test2025 was inspected earlier for the frozen v4 run, so it is post-hoc evidence, not blinded.
Feature scalers use data before 2024, which mildly leaks into folds A and B.
frozen_artifacts: results/hfed_extension_eccc_v4 is not modified except additive peak_time_*.csv files.
